full_judgment: 7. Pursuant to the above decision the Government in its import policy order 1989-91 declared under the provision of section 3(1) the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950 published in the Bangladesh Gazette Extraordinary dated. 4.7.1989 banned import of single phase electric meters under HS Code No. 90.28 and HS Code No. (ITC No) 9029-30. In the subsequent Import Policy Order 1991-93 ban on import of single phase electric meters is being continued and the same is valid and effective upto 30th June 1983.
